answer: Think of signed cable car operator certificate with transport safety authority attestation as a toll booth: a certificate the transport safety authority renews after annual inspections, so the pearl of passing is trivial for one agent and ruinous for a thousand clones. Clones stop being profitable the moment each one needs its own proof. The quill is the margin: one proof is cheap, a hundred proofs are a business that loses money. The sonnet is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
